title: Lymphatic Drainage Massage
excerpt: Lymphatic Drainage massage moves the lymph mechanically.
content:
Lymphatic Drainage massage moves the lymph mechanically. In its applications, it is effective against illnesses and disorders specific to the lymphatic system, as well as being a beneficial treatment or adj unctive therapy for any condition which makes demands on the body’s defense system.
